profile.headline: AI Engineer | Stanford, UT Austin
profile.summary:
I'm an AI Engineer working on an AI SRE agent. 

I have a strong background in machine learning: specializing in productionizing recommendations systems, pricing systems, and agents.

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Pricing
positions.description:
Key Achievements:
- Contributed to data and model training pipeline for TensorFlow-based pricing algorithm, leading to 10% performance uplift in gross profit
- Developed low-latency ML pricing web service in Go that performed experimentation, feature retrieval, model prediction, and price presentation with < 50 millisecond SLA
- Applied linear programming techniques to translate government regulations and business requirements into linear constraints within pricing models, handling peak throughput of 2,000 requests per second
- Spearheaded technical specifications, prototyping, software implementation, unit / integration testing, monitoring, and deployment of web service
- Built batch and streaming data pipelines for merchant features using Airflow, dbt, and Apache Flink SQL, increasing gross profit by 3%

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer / Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendations
positions.description:
Key Achievements:
- Led a team of 3 data scientists and data analysts that optimized a food delivery recommendation 
system
- Built recommendation system driving 2 million incremental bookings every month and leading to 15% performance uplift versus existing models (Patent No. 10201912472U).
- Implemented web service to retrieve and rank recommendations via Redis, an in-memory relational database (SingleStore), and TensorFlow

positions.title: Travel and Learning Sabbatical
positions.locationName: 42 countries across North America, South America, Europe, Africa, and Asia
positions.description:
Completed data science and machine learning coursework while traveling across 42 countries and 5 continents.

Focused on personal development, diverse experiences, and cultural immersion.

Pursued additional hobbies, including: learning Portuguese, trekking for two weeks in Himalayas, scuba diving in three continents, salsa dancing, kite surfing, and a 10-day Vipassana silent meditation retreat.

positions.title: Investment Banking Analyst (Technology)
positions.description: Performed data modeling and valuation analyses, and prepared client presentations for M&A and debt / equity financings
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Mathematics · Investment Banking · Project Management

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Conducted market research and issued recommendations to the second largest community foundation in the United States (with $1.8 billion assets under management) in its efforts to promote philanthropy among small and medium size businesses in Silicon Valley

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
Performed industry research in software and clean technology.

Helped startups in Spain to position themselves for the IBM Smartcamp and Cleantech Open competitions.

positions.title: Branch Manager
positions.description:
Led entrepreneurial business venture in the SAT Prep industry, constructing and executing sales and marketing plan

Tutored 16 students both privately and in a classroom setting and generated nearly $10,000 of revenue as a first-year branch manager
